description: Samara Heavrin, 18th District State Representative for the Commonwealth of Kentucky, was elected in November 2019 in a special election. When sworn into office, she became the youngest female ever elected to the Kentucky State House of Representatives. In the Kentucky State House of Representatives, Samara serves as Chair of the House Committee on Families ...
